TaskDescription: Dataset A, upper-limb condition: calibration task simulating the calibration stage of an upper-limb rehabilitation BCI. Both upper limbs were used. Visual cues (rest symbol, left arrow, right arrow; see stimuli/) instructed the participant to rest or to execute a brief hand movement on the left or right side. Each of the 4 runs contained 21 rest cues and 20 movement cues (10 left, 10 right), presented in pseudorandom order starting with a rest cue. Each movement cue (left or right arrow) was accompanied by a 1,000 Hz, 100 ms tone presented through loudspeakers (the same tone used as the movement cue in Datasets B and C); rest cues were silent. Movement cues were displayed for 2.5 s; rest cues were displayed for a random interval between 5 and 6 s.
Instructions: Watch the screen and follow the cue: remain at rest when the rest symbol is shown, or perform a brief hand movement on the side indicated by the arrow (left or right), which is accompanied by a beep.
